# Tapko

> Tapko adds custom trackpad gestures to your Mac: middle click, close the window under the cursor, open apps and more.

Tapko turns taps, swipes, pinches and holds into the things you do all day. Middle click, close a window, open Telegram. In every app.

## Facts

- What it is: a menu bar app that adds custom trackpad gestures to a Mac (taps, clicks, swipes, pinches, rotations, holds, TipTap)
- Made by: Stepanix (https://stepanix.com/), which also makes Klavko and Duesko
- Needs: macOS 14 Sonoma or later; works with the built-in trackpad and Magic Trackpad
- Price: free with 2 gestures at a time; Tapko Pro is $9.99 once, not a subscription
- Trial: every new install gets all of Pro for 7 days, no key or card needed
- Refunds: 14-day money-back guarantee
- Download: https://github.com/stepsergius/tapko-app/releases/latest/download/Tapko.dmg
- Website: https://tapko.stepanix.com/ (English), https://tapko.stepanix.com/uk/ (Ukrainian)

## Free edition

- 7 days of Pro included
- Then 2 gestures at a time
- All 26 actions
- Ready-made sets
- 11 languages

## Tapko Pro

- Unlimited gestures
- Per-app rules
- Use on up to 3 Macs
- Free updates

## Questions

### Why does Tapko need Accessibility access?

To click, press keys and close windows for you, macOS requires the Accessibility permission. Tapko uses it only to run the actions you set up.

### Does Tapko update itself?

Yes. Once a day Tapko checks for a new version and installs it after you agree. You can also check from the menu bar (Check for Updates…) or turn automatic checks off in Settings → About.

### Will it clash with the system gestures?

Tapko warns you when a gesture is also used by macOS, for example a three finger swipe, and opens the trackpad settings so you can turn the system one off.

### Is there a free trial?

Yes. Every new install gets all Pro features for 7 days, with no key or card needed. After that Tapko keeps working as the free version with 2 gestures, unless you buy Pro.

### How do I activate Pro?

After you buy, you get a license key by email. Paste it in Tapko → Settings → About.

### Can I get a refund?

Yes. If Tapko doesn't work for you, write within 14 days of purchase and you'll get your money back.
